primary_robustness_claim: GroundingDINO has higher full-manifest operational stability than YOLO-World at every registered replayable contract setting within each dataset

reasonable_domain_interpretation.tracked_candidate_count: two candidates are the minimum ranking problem and five is the frozen maximum tracked set
reasonable_domain_interpretation.exposed_candidate_count: ten to twenty tests whether a wider perturbed search pool changes missing-candidate or threatening-birth risk
reasonable_domain_interpretation.duplicate_iou_threshold: 0.50 to 0.85 spans strict object-level suppression to permissive retention of overlapping hypotheses
reasonable_domain_interpretation.match_iou_threshold: 0.10 to 0.25 allows corruption-induced displacement while rejecting associations with weak spatial continuity
reasonable_domain_interpretation.birth_duplicate_iou_threshold: 0.50 to 0.85 spans permissive to conservative definitions of spatial novelty

robustness_statistics.absolute_contract_envelope: minimum and maximum full-manifest operational stability over the complete replayable grid
robustness_statistics.same_contract_model_gap: GroundingDINO minus YOLO-World at each identical setting
robustness_statistics.ranking_invariance_condition: minimum same-contract model gap is strictly positive
robustness_statistics.strong_interval_separation_condition: minimum GroundingDINO stability exceeds maximum YOLO-World stability

existing_trace_limits.consequence: operational sensitivity to duplicate_iou_threshold and exposed counts above 20 is not identifiable from v1 traces

future_trace_requirements.purpose: permit offline replay of every registered output-contract parameter without new model inference

prohibited_after_freeze: changing the reasonable parameter domain after viewing enhanced sensitivity results
removing settings that reverse or weaken a preferred comparison
describing partial clean-only duplicate sensitivity as full operational sensitivity
claiming continuous-domain invariance from a finite registered grid
